text: The subject is Hamid Shah, who holds account PK**BAHL****5384 opened on 25 January 2020. The subject is declared to be a Medical sales officer (salaried) with a declared monthly income of PKR 220,000 per month. Between 1 May 2026 and 25 May 2026, the account recorded 14 credits totalling PKR 18,216,000 and 4 debits totalling PKR 14,854,000. The account received 13 cash deposits totalling PKR 17,996,000 across 4 branches (Clifton Branch, DHA Phase 6 Branch, Gulshan-e-Iqbal Branch, Saddar Branch). An alert was raised by Tazama on 25 May 2026, where the Tazama typology STR-PK-01 scored 320 against an alert threshold of 300. 9 of 13 cash deposits (69%) were between PKR 1,600,000 and PKR 1,999,999, totalling PKR 16,337,000, which is indicative of repeated deposits just below the cash transaction reporting threshold of PKR 2,000,000. The cash deposits were spread across 4 branches (Clifton Branch, DHA Phase 6 Branch, Gulshan-e-Iqbal Branch, Saddar Branch), a pattern consistent with suspected structuring. There was more than one cash deposit on 2 days (11 May 2026, 25 May 2026), which is indicative of structuring activity. Credits in the activity window were 82.8 times the declared monthly income of PKR 220,000 per month, suggesting cash volume inconsistent with the declared income. A note by Branch Operations on 14 May 2026 recorded that the customer asked why deposits of PKR 2 million or more need extra paperwork and declined to explain the source of the cash, which is consistent with suspected structuring. The pattern of 9 of 13 cash deposits (69%) between PKR 1,600,000 and PKR 1,999,999 across 4 branches (Clifton Branch, DHA Phase 6 Branch, Gulshan-e-Iqbal Branch, Saddar Branch) is consistent with suspected structuring to avoid the cash transaction reporting threshold of PKR 2,000,000. PKR 7,434,000 was sent to Sheraz Traders (PK**SHER****1518, Synthetic Bank A) in 2 transactions. PKR 7,420,000 was sent to Crescent Imports (PK**CRES****1592, Synthetic Bank A) in 2 transactions. Debits equal to 82% of credits were made with a median of 15.3 hours between the latest credit and each debit. There was no match on sanctions, PEP or adverse-media screening on 28 May 2026. The account was placed under enhanced monitoring pending the reporting decision.
